summary: Point Betsie Light, lit in 1858 at the south entrance to Lake Michigan's Manitou Passage, got a steam fog signal in 1891 and lost its keepers in 1983, among the last staffed Great Lakes lights.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record carries both 1858 and 1859. LighthouseFriends gives 20 October 1858 and the USLHS archive gives 1858 as established; the keeper roster begins in 1859. The NRHP nomination PDF is not digitised, so 1858 rests on LighthouseFriends.

The record's 'tower, concrete, built 1890' appears to reflect the 1890 concrete underpinning beneath the 1858 brick tower, not a second tower; the fog signal building was built 1891-92 (the 1912 date in the record matches LighthouseFriends' chime-whistle replacement and a rebuild reported elsewhere, not a first building).

notes_for_editor: The NRHP nomination (84001375) is not digitised, so the chronology rests on LighthouseFriends, Light-House Board and Life-Saving Service reports. LighthouseFriends is the only source for the 20 October 1858 first lighting, the 1880 Board quotation, the Matthews log, Sheridan's fall, the 1917 swap and the 2004-2022 chronology; the 1880 report itself is not in our corpus (it starts 1891). Disagreements: Sheridan/Danielsen change 1917 (USLHS, LighthouseFriends) vs 1919 (station personnel record); life-saving station 1876 (LighthouseFriends) vs 1875 (Wikipedia, not cited) vs 'four years' after October 1871 (Northern Michigan) vs 1877 (personnel record). The Northern Michigan article says the last keeper left in 1963 and full automation came in 1984; that conflicts with USLHS and LighthouseFriends (1983) and was not used. Fiscal years: the 'Michicott' row (22 May) in the 1893 report was matched by table position and its OCR prints the year as 1892 although the report covers July 1892 to June 1893, so 1893 is inferred; the Buffalo (30 Sept) event is in the fiscal 1888 report so is 1887; the John Cowan fire (1 Aug) is in the fiscal 1889 report so is 1888. Fog-signal hours: 418 read from OCR '418^'. The 1888 report's unnamed stranded steamer has no date in the text read. A newspaper search through research/newspapers.py timed out and was not used. Light data (characteristic, height 15.8 m, range 13.9 nm) are from the station record, not checked against a Light List. Danielsen is spelled Danielsen in LighthouseFriends and the USLHS roster. Slyfield's mynorth source spells the earlier keeper 'Peter Barnes' where the roster has Pitt D. Barnes.
